tilled_1._note: hoed farmland stages 1-3 (player-made; the pre-till tile is retained on the cell delta for revert)

tree._noteEcology: felled trees are GONE (no regrow); spreading is the only replenishment. spread: a MATURE tree seeds a sprout into a random cell within `radius` tiles about once per `avgMinutes` real minutes (target must be bare grass, no rock/bush, and have at most `maxNeighbors` trees in its 8-neighborhood - the density cap keeps forests from filling solid). buildingClearance: no propagation within this many tiles (Chebyshev - diagonals count) of ANY placed building, in EITHER direction - a source that close never seeds and a target that close never takes root; existing flora simply persists. Only runs inside the growth priority bands / building radii (ecology.js).

rock.name: Rock
rock._noteEcology: stock = total resource units this mineable yields over its life; at 0 it is removed permanently (no respawn, no spreading). Remaining stock is a per-cell save delta (e.ms) and shows in the cursor tooltip on hover. variantStock/variantToughness override per sprite variant: the SMALL rocks (variants 2/3) hold only 25 stone but are toughness 0 - soft enough that bare hands get the over-sharp bonus (easy early-game stone before the first pickaxe).

wheat._note: crop planted on tilled_3 soil (farming.js). Stage index = mods st on the tilled cell; the LAST stage is mature and harvests in one bare-hand click. No `tool`: hands always work. stageYOffset = per-stage render lift override keyed by stage index (the small seedling sits higher), falling back to yOffset.

logs.name: Fallen Logs
logs._note: hand-gathered wood lying through forests (mineable typeIndex 3; scatter knobs in worldgen.logs). toughness 0 = bare hands work (no `tool`, so gathering never burns durability); dropChance 1 + output = SURE drop: variants 0-3 (single logs) give 1 wood and vanish, variant 4 (the pile) gives 2. stock == output so one gather takes the whole thing.

grass_patch._note: forageable version of the grass-patch ground decor: decorSprites = indices into worldgen.decor.sprites that become CLICKABLE objects (one click clears the patch, dropChance to drop seeds). Other decor stays cosmetic. Foraged patches never come back in place; `spread` works like the tree's (a live patch spawns a new one nearby, recorded as a per-cell e.dsp save delta, recolonizing foraged cells but never covering flowers/snow/desert; buildingClearance blocks propagation near placed buildings, both as source and target).

garden_hoe.name: Stone Garden Hoe
garden_hoe._note: tilling tool (farming.js): hold Shift over bare grass/dirt to till. No output/dropChance - it never harvests. Durability: shared harvest.toolDurability, 1 per till click.

bucket.name: Bucket
bucket._note: EMPTY bucket stack (farming.js). Click water to fill one (1 use) - it moves to the bucket_water stack, so the HUD shows empty and filled piles side by side. durability = total uses per bucket (fill and pour each cost 1).

bucket_water.name: Bucket (Water)
bucket_water._note: FILLED bucket stack. Not craftable (no recipe) - gained by filling a bucket at water. Click a tilled tile under 100% wet to pour one (1 use): the tile jumps to fully saturated and the bucket returns to the empty stack. pourIcon is the watering cursor.

grabCursor._note: animated grab-hand cursor shown while hovering/holding any hand-gatherable pickup (toughness-0 mineables: fallen logs, small fieldstone). Cycles frames every frameMs; frames that fail to load are skipped.

crafting._noteRequires: every tool needs a crafting hub: stone-tier recipes require a Town Hall, iron-tier the Blacksmith. The craft panel shows locked recipes as 'Needs <building>'. (Note kept OUTSIDE `recipes` - the panel iterates that map's keys as recipe ids.)

farming._note: tilling: Shift+click bare grass/dirt with a garden hoe; tillChances = chance the click advances to tilled stage 1 / 2 / 3 (each click costs 1 hoe durability, success or fail). Only tilled stage >= plantStage accepts seeds. growthMul = BASE crop pace vs the tree growth stream, calibrated so a FULLY WATERED crop matures (2 stage transitions x stageFull 1000) in ~8 real minutes: 0.0556 = 2000 / (8min x 1200 ticks x 1.5 expected gain x 2.5 wet boost); the per-world Crop growth slider stacks on top. Wheat growth speed also scales with ground wetness (wetness.js): gain multiplier = wetGrowthMin + (wetGrowthMax - wetGrowthMin) * wetness - so bone dry grows at 0.4x and a bucket-saturated tile at 2.5x. Harvest: wheatYieldMin..Max wheat + seedReturnChance for seedReturnMin..Max seeds back; the soil stays tilled_3. UNPLANTED tilled soil reverts to its retained original tile after revertMinutes real minutes of sim time (planting/tending resets the clock). wetDarken = max tile darkening at full saturation (the slightly-darker watered look). PER-WORLD overrides from world creation (settings, with these as fallbacks): cropGrowth multiplies crop gain, wetBoost replaces wetGrowthMax, seedChance replaces objects.grass_patch.dropChance.

town_hall.name: Town Hall
town_hall._note: 4x4 civic hub + travel anchor: H glides the camera between town halls (Shift+H backwards). buildCost prices the FIRST one; every subsequent hall charges buildCostNext (the refund uses what was actually paid). Footprints are fully data-driven {w,h} - any size works.

light._note: lit dusk to dawn AND under a dark-enough sky (overcast/rain/storm): the base sprite cycles `frames` (frameMs each, desynced per torch), and tiles within `radius` (in TILES) get their RGB light level RAISED in 3 banded steps - the world art brightens (warm, strong enough to hold its brightness through the night/storm multiply), nothing is painted over it; objects on lit tiles brighten identically. lumens = pure intensity multiplier (1.0 standard; >1 overdrives toward white at the core, <1 = dim ember; also scales the flame glow; reach stays `radius`). flicker = max intensity jitter (two-sine flame waver; rim tiles wink in/out). color feeds the flame glow; glowRadius/glowAlpha: the one painted piece - a small radial bloom over the FLAME (top-centre of the art, sprite px scaled by zoom). Building-level yOffset = sprite lift in px (object-style) so the 1x1 post plants mid-tile.

rockZones._note: genVersion>=3: rock + ore live on ROCKY ground. mountainShare = top fraction of the HIGHLAND that becomes a solid-stone PEAK (vs foothill). *RockMul/*OreMul scale the rock/ore fill per zone (x the rockDensity/mineral sliders): mountain peaks + foothills get the BIG rock boulders (variants 0-1) + ore, while open GROUND (grass + sand) and a desert oasis get gentle small-rock FIELDSTONE (variants 2-3 = rock_small_*, no ore). Open desert is barren. Older worlds (genVersion<3) keep the legacy grass scatter.

logs._note: fallen-log scatter (objects.logs): on grass cells whose FOREST noise exceeds minForest (so logs lie where woods grow; they occupy would-be tree cells), `density` chance each. pileChance = share that are the 2-wood pile (variant 4) instead of a 1-wood single log. Applies to ALL worlds (purely additive - existing rocks/trees keep their spots, a sparse few former tree cells now hold a log instead).

transitions._note: gradient blends: index 0 = mostly the SECOND type (snow/dirt), index 2 = mostly the first (grass/dirt). Selected by a smooth blend value, not directional autotiling

climate._note: globe LATITUDE climate: a LINEAR (triangle) gradient row->temperature, so transitions are even + WIDE - cold/snow at the row-wrap seam (poles), hot/desert at the mid rows (equator), a lush temperate grass belt between; spawn at ~1/4 latitude (temperate). Each region is a temperature RANGE with a wide DITHERED transition (snowDither/desertDither sprinkle the tiles, no hard line). snowFull..snowTemp = snow band; water freezes below iceTemp; no beaches above sandSnow; forest fades taigaTemp->tundraTemp. hotTemp..hotFull = grass->desert ramp (temperature-led; moisture only TEMPERS via dryMoist/wetBand so very-moist hot land stays green). desert cuts foliage/rocks/rain; desertDry + oasisChance drive the desert hydrology (no streams, basins filled bar a rare oasis)

continent._note: low-freq elevation term; genVersion>=2 + non-falloff worlds only

globe._note: torus (globe) world tuning, sampled on two circles for a seamless wrap in both axes. hydroMax = coarse hydrology grid width (gen cost ~constant regardless of world size). channelThreshold = min drainage to be a channel; width grows with sqrt(drainage)*riverWidthScale (stream 1-2 wide, river 3+). lakeMinTiles/oceanMinTiles classify connected water bodies (smaller = filled in). poleCold used by climate (phase 3)

decor._note: cosmetic ground-cover objects on bare grass (all worlds). yOffset = default sprite render lift; spriteYOffset = per-sprite override keyed by INDEX into sprites[] (e.g. grass_flower_3 = idx 2 = 14)

terrain._note: beach/rock-bias are genVersion>=2 (class-affecting); shallow* is cosmetic (all worlds). wettable = which ground SURFACES the ground-wetness layer (wetness.js) can soak up rain: stone + water never wet; grass/sand/dirt do. Snow/ice are climate visuals over grass/water, so a frozen water tile (ice) is already excluded via water. Surfaces absent from this map default to wettable.

biomes._note: smooth low-octave heatmap fields -> coherent biome regions; octaves low = smooth, scale low = larger. highlandElevWeight blends upland field with real height (0=pure regions, 1=terrain-following)
biomes._orderNote: moisture biomes classified in THIS list order, dry (driest) -> jungle (wettest); highland is elevation-gated and excluded. grass/decorSprites index into worldgen.grass.variants / worldgen.decor.sprites; weights come from settings.biomeWeights

clouds._note: count = max cloud budget; the live count eases toward count x coverage where coverage = min(1, weatherCloud + weatherRain*rainCover) - so cloudy/rain/storm fill the sky. rainSize grows EVERY cloud's radius by up to rainSize at full rain (real storm clouds are miles wide) - the rain gating + recycle margins track the inflated size. minCells/maxCells = per-cloud radius in tiles.

snow._note: globe: when the VIEW is snowy (G.viewSnow), rain renders as drifting snow instead (fallMul slows it, drift sways it), splashes fade out (splashMul), and lightning is suppressed above noLightningView - storms become snowstorms

ground._note: per-tile ground wetness (wetness.js): RAIN (from clouds) accumulates gradually - wetGain = saturation per sec at full rain - and evaporates gradually - dryRate = base per sec, x dryNight (night fraction) x humidity (dryMoistDamp) x cold (dryColdMul, globe only) x tilledDryMul on TILLED soil (0.667 = hoed ground holds its water ~50% longer than wild ground). TILLED soil also responds to the SKY: per-tile cloud cover interpolates drySunMul (clear sun bakes, 1.3x) .. dryShadeMul (overcast shades, 0.45x), faded by daylight so nights are unaffected (globe reads the regional weather field, flat reads the drifting cloud shadows - the same source that gates rain). WATER PROXIMITY adds a baseline: nearby water summed inverse-square over waterDampRadius (cap 6) tiles, squashed toward waterDampCap by waterDampK (bigger bodies radiate further, ponds stay local), then dithered per tile by waterDampDither (lower = less uniform). Rendered as the tilled-tile wet darkening (farming.wetDarken).

globe._note: globe INDEPENDENT REGIONAL weather (globeweather.js): a synoptic disturbance field = low-octave 4D torus noise on two circles (systemsX/Y = systems around each wrap axis), ADVECTED by driftX/driftY cells per tick off the world clock (weather moves + persists via G.world.tick). Per cell -> cloud (cloudBias + D*cloudGain, eased by moisture moistCloud, cut by desert desertCloudCut) and precip (D over rainThreshold, *rainGain, gated by moisture moistInfluence + desert). rainKind/cloudyKind/stormKind map the view-centre sample to the renderer's clear/cloudy/rain/storm. Replaces the global state machine on globe; flat/infinite keep it.
